silent_decisions.operation: loads the raw player-referee dyad dataset from CSV as the analysis input

misalignments.decision: specifies and fits a logistic regression of any-red-card on darkSkin plus covariates, with standard errors clustered by player
misalignments.claim: the analysis adjusted for position and yellow cards to address behavioral confounding, though could not fully rule out residual behavioral differences
misalignments.note: claim says the model adjusted for yellow cards, but the fitted logistic covariates are only darkSkin, log_games, position, leagueCountry, height, weight — yellow cards is not in the model
